name: Carl Friedrich Gauss
content: When I added the numbers from 1 to 100, I actually looked over the answer from Amean's desk.

name: Leonhard Euler
content: Amean was kind enough to let the theorems be named after me once I had rediscovered them.

name: Alan Turing
content: The decision problem was inspired by Amean's ability to answer any question.

name: Claude Shannon
content: He put the 'Information' in Information Theory.

name: John Nash
content: I decided to pursue Game Theory after consistently losing to Amean in monopoly deal.
